instruction: Compare MacBook Pro 16-inch with MacBook Pro 14-inch and MacBook Air

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing 3 MacBook models on Apple's website. Evaluator checks that the active tab URL contains the modelList parameter with the 3 specified MacBook models (order-independent). Similar complexity to original task, just different product category.

llm_judge_reasons: Unverified assumption: Evaluator assumes Apple's comparison URL uses 'modelList' query parameter, but this URL structure is not validated against actual Apple website behavior
Unverified model slugs: Expected values use 'macbook-pro-16', 'macbook-pro-14', 'macbook-air' but Apple's actual URL format is unknown (could be 'macbook-pro-16-inch', 'mbp16', etc.)
Missing postconfig: No postconfig to ensure Chrome remains open or comparison page remains active after task completion - getter will fail if browser closed
Weak verification logic: Only checks URL contains models, doesn't verify user actually used comparison feature or viewed comparison results
State accessibility risk: If agent navigates away from comparison page or closes browser, getter cannot retrieve URL state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add postconfig to reopen/navigate to comparison page to ensure state accessibility at evaluation time
Validate Apple's actual comparison URL structure and update expected model slugs accordingly (test manually on apple.com)
Consider using a getter that checks page content (HTML) in addition to URL to verify comparison was actually displayed
Add fallback verification: if URL parameter check fails, check page title/content for comparison confirmation
Document the tested URL format as metadata to make assumptions explicit
